method: The built-in browser pane at 375 x 812 (mobile emulation), the Next.js dev server on :3000 against the demonstration API on :8000, dark colour scheme, English. BEFORE = measured at the start of the sprint on main; AFTER = this branch, same pages, same function, same accounts (+919000000006 and +919000000012/13, none of them golden). NOT the capture script and NOT the sweep (no Chromium on the machine); comparable with each other, not with earlier sprints' files. A control under 44 px is an a/button/select/input/textarea/[role] narrower or shorter than 43.5 px; a checkbox or radio is measured by its label (as the sweep does); a sentence's inline link is listed but is exempt in the sweep's own rule and in WCAG 2.5.8.
